Waffarha negotiates discounted, ready-to-use offers on your behalf with stores and service providers, using group buying: when enough people are interested in an offer, Waffarha negotiates as a single large buyer, letting the seller offer a much bigger discount than they could to an individual. The offers on Waffarha are not available directly from the seller at the same price.
